title: hath0r.cli.kb-path.data/1
description: Command-specific data payload for the kb.path operation (HATHOR-TS-005 §11). Placed under response envelope field data when command is kb.path. Path is operator data; POC adapters must strip it from normal browser responses.

configured.description: Whether a knowledgebase path is configured for the group.

available.description: Whether the configured knowledgebase directory is present and usable.

path.description: Absolute local knowledgebase path. Optional; present in operator/verbose mode. Must not appear in normal browser-facing POC payloads.
